SECOND TERM E-LEARNING NOTES JS 3 (BASIC 9) IGBO LANGUAGE NTUPUTA IHE OMUMU (SCHEME OF WORK)
WEEK                 TOPIC
1                    Mmeghari ihe ndi a muru na taam gara aga
2-3                   Akwukwo agumagu ahoputara: 1. Ogugu akwukwo ahoputara 2. Nkowa isi ihe akwukwo na-   ekwu maka ya 3. Nkowa okwu ufodu di n’akwukwo 4. Agwa ufodu di n’akwukwo aguru 5. Uche umuaka banyere isi ihe aguru na agwa ufodu.
4-5.                  Nkebiokwu: 1. Ihe bu nkebiokwu 2. Nkebiokwu di iche iche di ka keaha, kekowaaha, kambuuzo, kenruaka 3. Mmebe ahiriokwu nwere nkebiokwu 4. Njirimara  nkebiokwu
6.                     Akaoru: 1. Ihe bu akaoru 2. Udi akaoru di iche iche 3. Ozuzu maka aka oru 4. Uru akaoru bara
7-8.                  Nkebiahiri: 1. Ihe bu nkebiahiri 2. Nkebiahiri di iche iche 3. Ngosi   nke
9-10                Ikwado na inye nwaanyi ikike na ohere di ka ndi nwoke:
1. Uzo di iche    iche aga esi nye nwaanyi ohere
2. Etu aga e si kwado nwaanyi.
3  Ebe di iche iche nwaanyi nwere ike puta n’ochichi
4. Umunwaanyi ndi nweterela ezigbo onodu n’ochichi gomenti
11.                   Mmeghari

IGU AKWUKWO A HOPUTARA
NDINAYA
I)  Aha akwukwo na odee ya-.Aha akwukwo a ga-eleba anya bu Oke Soro Ngwere Maa Mmiri.O bu Maazi Isaac Udechukwu dere ya .E dere ya n’afo 1998.Ndi biputara ya bu Pacific publisher’s nke di n’Obosi Anambra steeti .
ii)  Udi akwukwo- o bu iduazi ma burukwa akuko a roro aro.
iii)   Ntoala Akwukwo -Akuko mere n’obodo a na-akpo Igboeze .Ndi ebu n’uche were dee ya bu ohaneeze.O bu banyere ihe na-eme n’oge ugbu a.
iv)  Usoro akuko-Eji Igbo Izugbe were dee ya.E webatara olumba ole na ole
v)   Isiokwu-Dika aha akwukwo a siri di,o dighi mma mmadu ime ihe n’ihi na o  huru ndi ozo ka ha na-eme ya.

Kedu aha akwukwo a hoputara?
Kedu ihe bu isiokwu akwukwo a?
IKOWA ISI IHE AKWUKWO NA-EKWU MAKA YA
NDINAYA
Mazi udu na nwunye ya nwannediya mutara umu ato.Ha bu Ndidi, Ogeri na Ikechi. Ikechi bu nani nwoke .O no n’Onicha  na nke nwanne nna ya agu akwukwo primari.N’ihi mkpamkpa ndi otu nzuzo na-akpa n’uloakwukwo di n’obodo mepere emepe,nna ya kpoghachiri ya azu n’ime obodo ha. O norozie n’ulo gutopu akwukwo primari  baa koleeji.O guchaghi koleeji n’ihi na o tinyere isi n’otu  nzuzo e wee gbara ya ugbo nwamkpi. O jere muo ka esi akwo ugboala.O kwokatara ugboala bido tuba mgbere anwuru ike .Ka o bu anwuru ike a alota Naijiria,aka kpaara ya.Ahuhu e nyere ya bu na a gbara ya ogwu ojoo si ya laba .O bu ogwu ahu a gbara ya ka o na-ariazi weenwuo.
NNWALE
Akwukwo a na-ako maka onye?
Kedu ihe gburu Ikechi?

5 Kedu ahuhu e nyere Ikechi--(a)a gbara ya ogwu (b)e nyere ya ego (c)e tiri ya ihe (d)a turu ya mkporo.

IHE BU AKAORU
NDINAYA
Akaoru bu ihe mmadu na-eme wee na-enwete ego. A na-eji aka oru mmadu amata ya .Onye nwere aka oru nwere ihe kpatara o jiri horo oru ahu .O nwere ike buru na o na- enye ego karia oru ndi ozo ma o bu na o nwere ihunanya ebe oru ahu di ma o bu na ohanaeze na akwanyere ndi na-aru ya ugwu.Ufodu aka oru sitere n’agburu.Inwe akaoru na-eme ka mmadu nwee ego ma gbokwaa mkpa diiri ya.A na-ele onye enweghi akaoru anya  di ka onyeohi ma o bu ofeogori.

1.Gini bu akaoru?
2.Depute ihe ato  a na- ebu n’obi oge a na a horo aka oru?

a: akaoru nkeodinaala
b:akaoru ogbara ohuru
a; Akaoru nkeodinaala

OZUZU N’AKAORU
NDINAYA
Akaoru bu ihe a na amu amu muta ya nke oma  tupu e nwee ya.Onye choro imu akaoru ga- aga n’aka onye maara ya ka o kuziere ya akaoru ahu.O bu oru diiri nne na nna iziga umu ha ebe ha ga-amuta akaoru nke oge ochie. Oge ufodu,a naghi a naghi agba aka aga.A na-eji ego ma o bu oji ario onye ga-akuziri gi aka oru ahu.
Akaoru ogbara ohuru choro ima ka esi ede na ka esi agu.N’ihi nke a onye choro imuta akaoru nke ogbara ohuru ga- aguriri akwukwo di ka o kwesiri tupu o tozuo iru ya bu oru.E nweela ulo akwukwo ebe a na-azu umuakwukwo n’aka oru di iche iche.Ulo akwukwo ndi a bu,
Uloakwukwo nke Nkanauzu--school of science and technology
Uloakwukwo ndi nkuzi--teachers training college
Uloakwukwo ndi na-esi nri -catering school
Uloakwukwo ndi iwu--law school.
Uloakwukwo ndi nche- police college.  Dgz

- Kedu ihe onye choro akaoru oge ochie  ga-eme tupu omuta ya?
- Depute ulo akwukwo ano ebe mmadu ga-amuta akaoru ogbara ohuru?

O na-enye ugwu
E ji ya amata akaraka mmadu
O na-eme ka mmadu nwee akunauba
O na-eme ka mmadu kwuru onwe ya.
O na-eme ka ime mpu laa
O na-akwalite asompi n’ihe onye maara eme.
O na-ewete aguu igu akwukwo.

NKEBIAHIRI DI ICHE ICHE
NDINAYA
E nwere nkebiahiri di iche iche na-aru oru di iche iche n’ahiriokwu.Ha bu:
1.Nkebiahiri keaha
2.Nkebiahiri kenkowaaha
3.Nkebiahiri Kenkwuwa
1.Nkebiahirikeaha:
Nke a bu nkebiahiri na-aru oru dika aha.O nwere ike ibu isiokwu ma o bu nnara n’ahiriokwu ya bu na o nwere ike ibido okwu ma o bu noro  na mmechi okwu.
O bu eziokwu na nkebiahiri keaha nwere ngwaa mana nke a emeghi nghota ya zuo oke.
Omumaatu:
i- Ha amaghi ihe e kwuru
ii-O siri na aguu na-agu ya
iii- Akwa o bere meturu m n’obi
iv-Chinelo siri na ya na-abia
v-Akwa o tara di ya mma n’ahu
2.Nkebiahiri kenkowaaha:
Nke a na-akowa aha di n’ahiriokwu.O ga-ekwu udi  ya na nke 0 bu.o na-aza ajuju kedu,nke,ma o bu,kedu udi.
omumaatu:
i-Onye ohi nke a gbajiri out aka anwuola
ii- Ewu nke di ime agbafuela
iii- Onye ruru ulo a bu enyi m
iv-Ule akwukwo nke e lere na taam a di mfe
v-Umuakwukwo ndi na-agba mbo ga- agafe n’ule
vi-O nyere m ego buru ibu
3.Nkebiahiri kenkwuwa
O bu nkebiahiri e ji nkwuwa emebe.
Omumaatu:
i-Amaghi m mgbe o biara
ii-O nuru mmiri ka o richara nri
iii-Ha kpere ekpere tupu ha ebido mmemme.
iv-O na-ekwu okwu ka onye amaghi ihe
v-Chijindu nwetara oru ozugbo o guchara akwukwo

2.Were omumaatu ato meputa nkebiahiriokwu abuo abuo n’udi nkebiahiri e nwere?

3.Deputa udi nkebiahiri na nke a kara ihe n’okpuru
